newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tabcorp says placed to improve EPS.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tabcorp says placed to improve EPS.

text.p: Wagering and gaming group Tabcorp Holdings Ltd is well placed to improve earnings per share and dividend growth in 1996/97, chairman Michael Robinson said on Tuesday.
Robinson told the annual meeting the company achieved a net profit of $87.2 million in its first full year of operations, against $63.4 million for the first 10 and a half months.

"The board of directors is well aware of the challenges of utilising the company's strong cash flows and debt-free balance sheet to enhance the wealth of our shareholders through earnings per share and dividend growth," he said.
"We believe the decisions taken over the past year leave the company well placed to achieve these goals."
At 11.00 a.m. (2400 GMT), Tabcorp shares were trading three cents lower at $5.87.
